remarks: Welcome to this light filled 4-bedroom Colonial perfectly situated just steps from the heart of New Canaan on the grounds of the New Canaan Museum and Historical Society campus. This freshly painted 4 bedroom home features an east-west orientation, filling every room with natural light throughout the day. The spacious layout includes generous living and dining areas opening onto the new deck ideal for entertaining and outdoor dining. Additional highlights include a lower level walk out playroom, 4th bedroom/bath and office and plenty of off-street parking. Enjoy the ultimate convenience of living minutes to shops, top-rated restaurants, and the train.  Lawn maintenance, parking snow plow and water included in the rent.
